label: No moral sentence is robustly truth-apt, by Modus tollens
meaning: Take any moral sentence. Our thought and talk explain its truth conditions (anti-realist order), so its truth conditions do not explain that thought and talk (asymmetry). Were it robustly truth-apt, they would (the explanatory bridge, an unattributed open premise stronger than Dreier's 'suited to explanatory work'). So it is not robustly truth-apt.
